                 Dear Ms Graham
                 Re: Mr Barry Jones       DOB: 11/06/1973

                 I am writing with regard to address Mr Jones, who wants to return to his work after back injury. Your further assessment of his
                 workplace would be highly appreciated.

                 Regarding the social history of Mr Jones, he was working in a large warehouse as a driver of forklift, which requires sitting for long
                 time and occasional heavy lifting. He is on naproxen and carisopradol.

                 On 31/05/2019, he presented at my clinic with complaint of back pain after lifting heavy box off floor at his work since 4 days. An X-
                 ray revealed no disc abnormalities, my provisional diagnosis was sever lower back strain. I commenced him on gradual daily
                 walking and referral to physiotherapist. In addition 30 days off work and a medical certificate given to an employer, along with follow
                 up in 30 days.

                 On today’s visit, Mr Jones recovery doing well and increase the range of movement. According to physiotherapy he still attending
                 the appointments regularly and walking for thirty minutes per day. He advised to return to his work without heavy lifting with regular
                 breaks.

                 In view of the above, your evaluation of Mr Jones workplace and provide advice to what duties he could perform would be greatful.

                 Yours sincerely
                 Doctor
